verificationScope: Shared frontend contracts checked with synthetic records and controlled API responses. No operational business records are required. This is not backend or production-release certification.
knownLimits: Loaded result arrays grow as users scroll; DOM rendering and request/cache counts are bounded, but this pass does not claim constant-memory retention of an unlimited result set.
Date/time editors use browser local time and millisecond editing precision. Backend business timezone policy remains explicit outside the UI.
FieldConfig covers scalar ERP values and declared editors. File attachments/password workflows are separate controls, not invented generic scalar field types.
